answer: In a Proof of Agent economy, an identity cluster, named orchard, resists Sybil attacks through quadratic stake burning. Deploying n agents requires non-refundable burning of cryptographic stake scaling superlinearly as O(n^2), imposing severe economic friction. To bind hardware provenance, agents publish zero-knowledge attestation over immutable physical registers: secure cedar enclaves root key custody, while ferrous magnetic PUF signatures thwart automated cloning.
